title: Shortcut platform and key matching lack focused regression coverage
reasoning: The feature contains user-visible shortcut behavior with platform-dependent global shortcut selection, accelerator normalization, label lookup, and DOM keyboard-event filtering, but the feature metadata lists no linked tests even though the frontend has a Jest test command. A regression here could silently display or accept the wrong stop shortcut on a platform, or fail to ignore repeated/modifier Escape events, without any focused test catching it.
recommendation: Add focused Jest coverage for darwin, win32, and linux platform label resolution; valid and invalid accelerator normalization; label fallback behavior; and isAgentStopShortcutEvent handling of Escape/Esc, repeat events, and modifier keys.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no tests, and the included package manifest only shows generic Jest commands rather than a linked test for this shortcut module.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a frontend Jest test module for agentStopShortcut.js that stubs navigator.userAgentData.platform or navigator.platform and asserts platform-specific options plus keyboard-event acceptance/rejection cases.
minimumFixScope: Add focused tests for frontend/src/renderer/infrastructure/shortcuts/agentStopShortcut.js without changing runtime behavior.
